35 · 矩阵分式函数与上图应用35 · Matrix-fractional functions and LMIs

Lecture 4 · PDF pp.28-32 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.1.5；3.1.7；A.5.5 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：用 Schur 补把矩阵分式函数上图写为半正定约束。Learning goal: explain matrix-fractional functions and lmis and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

正定域上的矩阵分式联合凸，上图集可写成 PSD 块约束。The matrix fraction is jointly convex on its positive definite domain; its epigraph is a PSD block constraint.

了解Understand

矩阵分式 f(x,Y)=xᵀY⁻¹x 的域为 Y≻0。需要判断 x、Y 同时变化的联合凸性，不能仅固定 Y 看二次函数。标量情形为 x²/y，y>0。The matrix-fractional function f(x,Y)=xᵀY⁻¹x requires Y≻0. Joint convexity concerns changes in both variables, beyond fixing Y to get a quadratic. Its scalar version is x²/y for y>0.

由 Schur 补，f≤t 等价于上述 PSD 分块约束。块元素对 (x,Y,t) 仿射，PSD 锥和正定域均凸，故上图集凸。例 (1,1)、(3,1) 中点值 4，小于端点平均 5。Schur complementation turns f≤t into the displayed PSD block constraint. Its entries are affine, and the PSD cone and positive definite domain are convex, proving epigraph convexity. For (1,1),(3,1), the midpoint value 4 is below endpoint average 5.

掌握Mastery

取任意两个上图集点，其分块矩阵混合后仍半正定，混合 Y 仍正定，再用 Schur 补反向还原，得到函数的凸性不等式。Mix two epigraph points. Their block matrix stays PSD and their Y stays positive definite. Applying the Schur complement in reverse yields the function's convexity inequality.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

写出 x²/y≤4、y>0 的 2×2 矩阵约束。Write x²/y≤4, y>0 as a 2×2 matrix constraint.

展开核对Check the answer

[[y,x],[x,4]]⪰0，并保留 y>0。Use [[y,x],[x,4]]⪰0 together with y>0.

深入In depth

定义域 Y≻0 不可省；奇异 Y 不能代入原来的逆矩阵公式。Keep Y≻0: a singular matrix cannot be substituted into the original inverse formula.

36 · Jensen 不等式：从两点到有限点36 · Jensen’s inequality and the homework checkpoint

Lecture 4 · PDF pp.33-34 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.1.8 · HW1 4(c)

学完应能：按总权重分组归纳；单独处理分组权重为零的情况。Learning goal: explain jensen’s inequality and the homework checkpoint and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

Jensen 将两点凸性推广到有限凸组合。Jensen extends two-point convexity to finite convex combinations.

了解Understand

Jensen 把两点凸性推广到 θᵢ≥0、Σθᵢ=1 的有限平均。以平方函数、观测 1、3、等权为例，均值平方 4≤平方均值 5。差值来自数据的波动。Jensen extends two-point convexity to finite averages with θᵢ≥0,Σθᵢ=1. For readings 1,3 with equal weights, the squared mean 4 is below the mean square 5; the gap measures variation.

所有输入须在凸定义域中；凹函数的不等号反向。严格凸且权重正时，取等须输入相同。作业 4(c) 可用有限版本，随机变量版本还需期望有意义。All inputs must lie in a convex domain; concavity reverses the inequality. Strict convexity and positive weights require equal inputs for equality. The finite version covers HW1 4(c); random-variable versions also require meaningful expectations.

至此已覆盖作业 1–5 的基础：对偶/诱导范数、log-sum-exp、凸集合与函数、Jensen、二阶锥。可先独立尝试，再按作业导航回查。This covers the foundations for HW1 1–5: dual and induced norms, log-sum-exp, convex sets and functions, Jensen and the SOC. Attempt the homework, then use its navigation to revisit relevant units.

掌握Mastery

归纳证明：将最后权重 t 分离，其余除以 1−t，先用归纳假设再用两点凸性。t=1 单独处理，零权重删除。积分形式还需可积性。Separate the final weight t, normalize the others by 1−t, then use induction and two-point convexity. Handle t=1 separately and discard zero weights. Integral versions need integrability.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

权重 (1/4,3/4)、数据 (0,4)，计算平方函数的 Jensen 两边。Compute both sides for the square function with weights (1/4,3/4) and data (0,4).

展开核对Check the answer

均值为 3，左边 9；右边 (1/4)0²+(3/4)4²=12，差为 3。The mean is three, giving nine on the left and twelve on the right, with gap three.

深入In depth

概率形式 f(E[X])≤E[f(X)] 也依赖期望存在，不能忽略可积条件。The probabilistic form f(E[X])≤E[f(X)] requires appropriate expectations and integrability.

37 · 非负加权和与仿射复合37 · Nonnegative sums and affine composition

Lecture 4 · PDF pp.36-38 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.2.1–3.2.2 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：逐条检查权重符号与复合的维数、定义域。Learning goal: explain nonnegative sums and affine composition and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

非负加权和与仿射复合保持凸性。Nonnegative weighted sums and affine composition preserve convexity.

了解Understand

非负加权和保持凸性：αᵢ≥0、fᵢ 凸，则 Σαᵢfᵢ 凸，域取共同定义域。最小二乘加 λ‖x‖₁（λ≥0）因此仍凸，λ 用于调节拟合与参数大小。Nonnegative weighted sums preserve convexity on the common domain. Thus least squares plus λ‖x‖₁ remains convex for λ≥0, trading fit against parameter size.

仿射复合 f(Ax+b) 也保持凸性。负系数通常使方向翻转，例如 −x² 凹；仿射项则允许任意系数。Affine composition f(Ax+b) preserves convexity. Negative weights generally reverse curvature, as −x² shows; affine terms permit either sign.

掌握Mastery

分别将凸性不等式乘 αᵢ≥0 再相加即可。仿射复合利用 A(θx+(1−θ)y)+b=θ(Ax+b)+(1−θ)(Ay+b)。Multiply each convexity inequality by αᵢ≥0 and sum. Affine composition follows because affine maps preserve mixtures.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

f(x)=(2x−1)²+3|x| 是否凸？用规则说明。Is (2x−1)²+3|x| convex? Explain using rules.

展开核对Check the answer

平方的仿射复合凸，绝对值凸，非负加权和凸。The affine composition of a square is convex, absolute value is convex, and their nonnegative weighted sum is convex.

深入In depth

λ 固定时的凸性不保证把 λ、x 同时作为变量仍联合凸。Convexity for fixed λ does not imply joint convexity in λ and x.

核对原课件 · 36-38Check original slides · 36-38

38 · 逐点最大、上确界与支撑函数38 · Pointwise maxima, suprema and support functions

Lecture 4 · PDF pp.39-44 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.2.3 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：读 max 与 sup；解释最大特征值凸性和仿射下界表示。Learning goal: explain pointwise maxima, suprema and s and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

逐点最大值或上确界保持凸性；逐点最小值一般不保持。Pointwise maxima and suprema preserve convexity; minima generally do not.

了解Understand

固定 x 后对一族凸函数取最大值或上确界，仍凸。例如 max(x²,(x−2)²) 在 x=1 切换主导项，可不可微而仍凸。逐点最小则不保证：min((x−1)²,(x+1)²) 两端为零，中点为 1。The pointwise maximum or supremum of convex functions is convex. For max(x²,(x−2)²), the active term switches at 1 without destroying convexity. Pointwise minima fail: min((x−1)²,(x+1)²) is zero at ±1 but 1 at their midpoint.

hC(z)=supₓ∈C zᵀx 是关于 z 的仿射函数上确界，故即使 C 不凸也凸。类似地 λmax(X)=sup‖v‖=1 vᵀXv 对对称 X 凸。The support function hC(z)=supₓ∈C zᵀx is a supremum of affine functions of z, hence convex even if C is not. Likewise λmax(X)=sup‖v‖=1 vᵀXv is convex for symmetric X.

掌握Mastery

每项 fα 在混合点≤θfα(x)+(1−θ)fα(y)≤θg(x)+(1−θ)g(y)。右侧与 α 无关，取上确界即证；也可用 epi g=∩α epi fα。Each fα at the mixture is bounded by θg(x)+(1−θ)g(y). Taking the supremum over α proves convexity. Equivalently, epi g=∩α epi fα.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

C=[−2,3] 的支撑函数是什么？Find the support function of C=[−2,3].

展开核对Check the answer

z≥0 时取 x=3，值为 3z；z<0 时取 x=−2，值为 −2z，即 max(3z,−2z)。For z≥0 choose three, giving 3z; for z<0 choose −2, giving −2z. Thus hC(z)=max(3z,−2z).

深入In depth

非空闭凸集可由所有支撑半空间重建，这是分离定理的应用。A nonempty closed convex set is reconstructed from its supporting halfspaces by separation.

核对原课件 · 39-44Check original slides · 39-44

39 · 标量与向量复合规则39 · Composition rules and their domain conditions

Lecture 4 · PDF pp.45-55 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.2.4 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：同时检查外函数凸性、单调性和扩展值定义域。Learning goal: explain composition rules and their domain conditions and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

外层凸且非减配内层凸；外层凸且非增配内层凹。Use convex inner maps with nondecreasing convex outer functions, concave inner maps with nonincreasing convex ones.

了解Understand

复合 h(g(x)) 的常用规则是：外层 h 凸且非减、内层 g 凸，则复合凸。非减保证内层的不等式方向通过外层后保留。若 h 非增，就需 g 凹。A standard rule makes h∘g convex when h is convex and nondecreasing and g convex. Monotonicity preserves the inner inequality. For nonincreasing h, use concave g instead.

因此 exp(‖x‖) 凸，正凹 g 的 −log g 和 1/g 凸。平方仅在非负区间非减，所以 ‖x‖² 可以用此规则，(x²−1)² 却无法仅凭“凸函数复合”判断。Thus exp(‖x‖) is convex; for positive concave g, −log g and 1/g are convex. Squaring is nondecreasing only on nonnegative inputs, so the rule handles ‖x‖² but does not justify (x²−1)².

多输入外层按坐标检查：非减坐标配凸内层，非增坐标配凹内层，仿射内层两者皆可。须检查域，教材用扩展值版本保证中间比较合法。非负凸 g 的 gᵖ（p≥1）及分量的 ℓp 组合也凸。For multivariate outer functions, pair nondecreasing coordinates with convex inner functions, nonincreasing ones with concave inner functions; affine inner functions allow either. Check domains using extended-value monotonicity. Powers p≥1 and ℓp combinations of nonnegative convex components are convex.

掌握Mastery

标量规则分两步：h(g(混合点))≤h(θg(x)+(1−θ)g(y))≤θh(g(x))+(1−θ)h(g(y))，依次用单调性与外层凸性。First use monotonicity to compare h(g(mixture)) with h(θg(x)+(1−θ)g(y)); then use outer convexity to obtain the weighted output bound.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

−log(1−x²) 在 −1<x<1 是否凸？Is −log(1−x²) convex on −1<x<1?

展开核对Check the answer

内层 1−x² 为正且凹，外层 −log 凸且非增，因此凸；定义域区间也凸。The inner function is positive and concave, and −log is convex and decreasing. The interval domain is convex, so the composition is convex.

深入In depth

log-sum-exp 联合凸且逐坐标非减，故 log Σexp(gᵢ) 在所有 gᵢ 凸时凸。Log-sum-exp is jointly convex and coordinatewise nondecreasing, so log Σexp(gᵢ) is convex for convex gᵢ.

核对原课件 · 45-55Check original slides · 45-55

40 · 部分最小化与函数透视40 · Partial minimization and function perspective

Lecture 4 · PDF pp.56-63 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.2.5–3.2.6 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：区分联合凸与分别凸；追踪 t>0；解释距离函数与二次透视。Learning goal: explain and function perspective and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

联合凸的保凸；透视 t f(x/t) 在 t>0 上保凸。Partial minimization of joint convexity preserves convexity, as does perspective t f(x/t) for t>0.

了解Understand

部分最小化先优化隐藏变量 y，留下 g(x)=infᵧ∈C f(x,y)。当 f 联合凸、C 凸时 g 凸。例如 (x−y)²+y² 在 y=x/2 最小，代回得 x²/2。分别对 x、y 凸不足以应用规则。Partial minimization g(x)=infᵧ∈C f(x,y) removes hidden variables. Jointly convex f and convex C give convex g. For (x−y)²+y², minimizing at y=x/2 gives x²/2. Separate convexity is insufficient.

函数透视为 t f(x/t)，t>0。平方的透视是 x²/t，−log 的透视是 −t log(x/t)：x/t 是单位规模状态，乘 t 得总费用。The perspective is t f(x/t), t>0. Squaring gives x²/t; −log gives −t log(x/t). The ratio represents a per-unit state and t scales its cost.

到非空凸集的距离 infᵧ∈C‖x−y‖ 是联合凸函数的部分最小化，故凸；最远距离 supᵧ∈C‖x−y‖ 由上确界规则凸，无须 C 凸，值可为 +∞。分式 ‖Ax+b‖²/(cᵀx+d) 在正分母域上也是透视的仿射复合。Distance to a nonempty convex set is partial minimization of jointly convex ‖x−y‖. Farthest distance supᵧ∈C‖x−y‖ is convex by the supremum rule, without convex C, and may be +∞. The fraction ‖Ax+b‖²/(cᵀx+d) is an affine composition of a perspective on its positive-denominator domain.

掌握Mastery

选 ε-近似最优 y₁,y₂，混合后用联合凸性得 g(混合 x)≤混合 g 值+ε，再令 ε↓0，无须最优 y 取得。Choose ε-optimal y₁,y₂ and mix them. Joint convexity bounds g at the mixture by weighted g values plus ε. Let ε↓0; attainment is unnecessary.

透视取 T=θt₁+(1−θ)t₂、α=θt₁/T，则混合 x/T=αx₁/t₁+(1−α)x₂/t₂。用 f 凸并乘 T 即证。分块 PSD 二次型消去 y 后得到 Schur 补费用 xᵀ(A−BC†Bᵀ)x，相容条件由整体 PSD 保证。For perspective, use T=θt₁+(1−θ)t₂ and α=θt₁/T, then apply convexity to αx₁/t₁+(1−α)x₂/t₂ and multiply by T. Eliminating y from a PSD block quadratic gives xᵀ(A−BC†Bᵀ)x; block PSD supplies range compatibility.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

f(x,y)=(x−y)²+4y² 对 y 消元，得到什么凸函数？Eliminate y from (x−y)²+4y².

展开核对Check the answer

导数为 −2x+10y，故 y*=x/5，代回为 4x²/5。The derivative is −2x+10y, giving y*=x/5 and minimum 4x²/5.

深入In depth

下确界 −∞ 或透视 t=0 的边界须用扩展值和极限另行处理。Infimum −∞ and the perspective boundary t=0 require extended-value and limit arguments.

核对原课件 · 56-63Check original slides · 56-63

LECTURE 05

共轭与广义凸性Conjugacy and generalized convexity

41 · 共轭函数的定义与几何41 · Conjugate functions: describe a curve by slopes

Lecture 5 · PDF pp.4-5 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.3 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：把共轭看成最紧仿射下界的截距；解释上确界和有效域。Learning goal: explain s: describe a curve by slopes and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

共轭在固定斜率下求线性收益减函数代价的上确界。The conjugate maximizes linear reward minus function cost at a fixed slope.

了解Understand

固定斜率 y，寻找不超过 f 的最高仿射下界 yᵀx−c。必须使 c≥yᵀx−f(x) 对所有 x 成立，故最小可行 c 为共轭 f*(y)=supₓ(yᵀx−f(x))。它用斜率描述函数。For fixed slope y, seek the highest affine lower bound yᵀx−c. Requiring c≥yᵀx−f(x) for every x gives the conjugate f*(y)=supₓ(yᵀx−f(x)), a slope-based description.

对 f(x)=x²/2，yx−x²/2=−(x−y)²/2+y²/2，故 f*(y)=y²/2。例如 y=2 给支撑线 2x−2，在 x=2 接触。共轭作为仿射函数上确界必凸，但可取 +∞。For f(x)=x²/2, completing the square gives f*(y)=y²/2, attained at x=y. Slope 2 gives support 2x−2 touching at x=2. A conjugate is always convex as an affine supremum, but may be +∞.

掌握Mastery

定义给 f(x)≥yᵀx−f*(y)。可微凸 f 若 ∇f(x*)=y，其切平面界保证 x* 最大化共轭目标，可代回求值。The definition gives f(x)≥yᵀx−f*(y). If differentiable convex f satisfies ∇f(x*)=y, its tangent bound proves x* maximizes the conjugate objective.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

f(x)=x²，求 f*(y) 并写出斜率 y=4 的支撑线。For f(x)=x², find f*(y) and the support with slope four.

展开核对Check the answer

为 x=y/2，共轭为 y²/4；斜率 4 时支撑线为 4x−4，接触 x=2。The maximizing point is y/2, giving f*(y)=y²/4. Slope four gives 4x−4, touching at x=2.

深入In depth

此处采用 Fenchel 上确界定义，允许不可微函数和受限域，无须梯度可逆。Fenchel's supremum definition permits nondifferentiability and restricted domains without an invertible gradient.

核对原课件 · 4-5Check original slides · 4-5

42 · 共轭函数的典型计算42 · Compute conjugates, including boundary cases

Lecture 5 · PDF pp.6-11 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.3.1 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：算仿射、负对数、指数、负熵、倒数、严格凸二次函数、负 log-det、示性/支撑函数与范数及范数平方的共轭；每例先检查定义域。Learning goal: explain compute conjugates, including boundary cases and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

计算共轭要核对定义域、无界方向、端点和取等。Conjugate calculations require domains, unbounded directions, endpoints and attainment.

了解Understand

共轭计算均从 supₓ(yᵀx−f(x)) 出发。仿射 f=ax+b 仅在 y=a 有值 −b，其余为 +∞。−log x（x>0）在 y<0 取 x=−1/y，得 −1−log(−y)，y≥0 时为 +∞。Always start from supₓ(yᵀx−f(x)). For ax+b, the conjugate is −b at y=a and +∞ otherwise. For −log x on x>0, y<0 gives optimizer −1/y and value −1−log(−y); otherwise the value is +∞.

eˣ 的共轭在 y>0 为 y log y−y，在 y=0 为 0（不取得），y<0 为 +∞。负熵 x log x（x≥0，0log0=0）的共轭为 exp(y−1)。1/x（x>0）的共轭在 y≤0 为 −2√(−y)，y=0 不取得；y>0 为 +∞。For eˣ, the conjugate is y log y−y for y>0, 0 at y=0 without attainment, and +∞ for y<0. Negative entropy x log x on x≥0, with 0log0=0, gives exp(y−1). The reciprocal 1/x on x>0 gives −2√(−y) for y≤0, unattained at 0, and +∞ for y>0.

δC 的共轭是支撑函数 hC。范数的共轭是对偶单位球的示性函数，½‖x‖² 则给 ½‖y‖*²。正定二次型的共轭权重变成逆矩阵，计算时须保留原有 ½ 系数。The conjugate of δC is its support hC. A norm gives the indicator of the dual unit ball; ½‖x‖² gives ½‖y‖*². Positive quadratic conjugates invert the matrix weight; retain the original ½ factors.

掌握Mastery

令 d=‖y‖*、r=‖x‖，有 yᵀx−½‖x‖²≤dr−r²/2≤d²/2。取对偶取等单位方向 u，再令 x=du 即达到；y=0 取 x=0。对范数本身，d≤1 时 x=0 取零，d>1 时沿 u 放大使目标无界。With d=‖y‖*,r=‖x‖, bound the objective by dr−r²/2≤d²/2. A maximizing unit direction u and x=du attain it; use x=0 when y=0. For the norm itself, d≤1 gives value 0 at zero, while d>1 allows unbounded scaling along u.

迹内积下，−logdet X（X≻0）的共轭仅在 Y≺0 有限，为 −n−logdet(−Y)，取 X=−Y⁻¹。Y 的非负特征方向使目标无界；负定时严格凹性保证候选最优。Under trace pairing, −logdet X has conjugate −n−logdet(−Y) for Y≺0, attained at X=−Y⁻¹. A nonnegative eigenvalue of Y makes the objective unbounded; for negative definite Y, strict concavity proves optimality.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

f(x)=2x² 的共轭是什么？eˣ 在 y=0 的共轭是否有最大化点？Find the conjugate of 2x². Does the conjugate of eˣ at y=0 have a maximizing point?

展开核对Check the answer

前者驻点 x=y/4，值 y²/8。后者值为 0，但任何有限 x 都使 −eˣ<0，因此不取得。The first gives x=y/4 and value y²/8. The second has value zero, unattained because −eˣ<0 at every finite x.

深入In depth

记表时同时记定义域、端点和是否取得；支撑函数双共轭回到 δC 需要 C 非空闭凸。Keep domains, endpoints and attainment with each formula. Recovering δC from its support conjugate requires nonempty closed convex C.

核对原课件 · 6-11Check original slides · 6-11

43 · Fenchel 不等式与变换规则43 · Fenchel’s inequality and conjugate transformations

Lecture 5 · PDF pp.12-14 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.3.2 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：由定义推 ；解释可微取等和变换的前提。Learning goal: explain fenchel’s inequality and conjugate transformations and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

Fenchel 不等式来自共轭定义；真闭凸函数等于双共轭。Fenchel's inequality follows from the definition; proper closed convex functions equal their biconjugates.

了解Understand

共轭定义立即给 Fenchel 不等式 f(x)+f*(y)≥yᵀx。等号表示 x 最大化共轭目标；可微凸时等价于 y=∇f(x)，一般凸时用 y∈∂f(x)。The conjugate definition gives Fenchel's inequality f(x)+f*(y)≥yᵀx. Equality means x maximizes the conjugate objective; for differentiable convex f this is y=∇f(x), or generally y∈∂f(x).

双共轭把仿射下界取上确界，真闭凸函数满足 f**=f。真指不取 −∞ 且不恒为 +∞，闭指上图集闭。一般只有 f**≤f。The biconjugate takes the supremum of affine lower bounds. Proper closed convex f satisfies f**=f. Proper excludes −∞ and identically +∞; closed means a closed epigraph. Generally only f**≤f holds.

独立变量的和可分别取共轭；同一变量上的和不能直接拆开。若 A 可逆，g(x)=f(Ax+b) 给 g*(y)=f*(A⁻ᵀy)−yᵀA⁻¹b。Sums on independent variables conjugate separately; sums on the same variable generally do not. For invertible A, g(x)=f(Ax+b) gives g*(y)=f*(A⁻ᵀy)−yᵀA⁻¹b.

掌握Mastery

a>0 时，(af)*(y)=a f*(y/a)，由正数提出上确界得到。仿射规则令 u=Ax+b，代入 x=A⁻¹(u−b)，分离常数即可。For a>0, factor a out of the supremum to obtain (af)*(y)=a f*(y/a). For the affine rule substitute x=A⁻¹(u−b) and separate the constant.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

g(x)=½(x−2)²，求共轭，并检查 Fenchel 等号条件。Find the conjugate of ½(x−2)² and its Fenchel equality condition.

展开核对Check the answer

令 u=x−2，得到 g*(y)=½y²+2y。等号条件为 y=x−2。Set u=x−2 to get g*(y)=½y²+2y. Equality holds when y=x−2.

深入In depth

一般凸函数的次梯度 y 满足 f(z)≥f(x)+yᵀ(z−x)，因而仍描述支撑斜率。A y satisfies f(z)≥f(x)+yᵀ(z−x), extending the supporting-slope description.

核对原课件 · 12-14Check original slides · 12-14

44 · 拟凸函数与保拟凸运算44 · Quasiconvexity: convex acceptability regions

Lecture 5 · PDF pp.16-25 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.4 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：用下水平集判断；辨析一阶必要条件与充分条件的假设。Learning goal: explain quasiconvexity: convex acceptability regions and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

拟凸等价于次水平集凸，可用门槛可行性二分求最优值。Quasiconvexity means convex sublevel sets; threshold feasibility enables bisection of the optimal value.

了解Understand

拟凸要求 f(θx+(1−θ)y)≤max(f(x),f(y))，等价于所有次水平集凸。单调一元函数如 x³、ceil(x) 都拟凸；同时拟凹称拟线性。正分母线性分式也拟线性，因固定门槛可交叉相乘成半空间。Quasiconvexity bounds mixture values by the larger endpoint value, equivalently requiring convex sublevel sets. Monotone scalar functions such as x³ and ceil(x) are quasiconvex; simultaneous quasiconcavity is quasilinearity. Positive-denominator linear-fractional functions are quasilinear because threshold constraints become halfspaces.

在开放凸域上，可微拟凸等价于：对所有 x,y，f(y)≤f(x)⇒∇f(x)ᵀ(y−x)≤0。某一点梯度为零无法单独判定；x³ 在 0 驻定却非最优。二阶必要条件只在梯度正交方向要求非负曲率；二次可微时，处处对每个非零正交方向严格正曲率，给拟凸的充分条件。On an open convex domain, differentiable quasiconvexity is equivalent to f(y)≤f(x) implying ∇f(x)ᵀ(y−x)≤0 for every pair. A zero gradient at one point proves little: x³ is stationary at 0 without being optimal. Second-order necessity requires nonnegative curvature on gradient-orthogonal directions; for C² functions, strict positivity at every point in every nonzero gradient-orthogonal direction is sufficient.

优化可二分门槛 α：检查是否存在 f(x)≤α 的可行点，逐次缩小已有上下界。上确界、非减复合、仿射或正分母线性分式复合保持拟凸；联合拟凸函数在凸约束下部分最小化也保持。Optimization can bisect a threshold α and solve convex feasibility f(x)≤α, narrowing established bounds. Supremum, nondecreasing composition, affine or positive-denominator fractional composition preserve quasiconvexity. Partial minimization of a jointly quasiconvex function over convex constraints also preserves it.

掌握Mastery

次水平集凸时，取 α=max(f(x),f(y)) 即得定义；反向用两端≤α 即证。上确界的次水平集是各项次水平集的交。非负加法一般不保持拟凸。Convex sublevel sets give the definition by choosing α=max(f(x),f(y)); the converse follows by bounding both endpoints by α. Supremum sublevel sets are intersections. Nonnegative sums generally do not preserve quasiconvexity.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

f(x)=x³ 的次水平集是什么？它为何拟线性却不凸？What are the sublevels of x³, and why is it quasilinear but not convex?

展开核对Check the answer

次水平集是 x≤α^(1/3)，超水平集也是半轴，均凸；但负 x 处二阶导数为负。Sublevels are x≤α^(1/3), and superlevels are opposite halflines, all convex. Negative x has negative second derivative.

深入In depth

拟凸的平坦区可产生非全局局部极小点，不能直接套用凸优化的最优性结论。Flat regions can give nonglobal local minima of quasiconvex functions, so convex optimality conclusions do not all transfer.

核对原课件 · 16-25Check original slides · 16-25

45 · 对数凸与对数凹45 · Log-convex and log-concave functions

Lecture 5 · PDF pp.27-29 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.5 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：先检查正性，再取对数；比较与普通凸凹的关系。Learning goal: explain and log-concave functions and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

/凹指 log f 凸/凹；前者蕴含凸，后者蕴含拟凹。Log-convexity or concavity concerns log f. They imply convexity or quasiconcavity, respectively.

了解Understand

正函数 f 对数凸/凹，指 log f 凸/凹。例如 exp(−x²/2) ，却不在全实轴凹；对数凹蕴含拟凹。对数凸则蕴含凸，由加权几何平均≤算术平均得到。A positive function is log-convex or when its logarithm is convex or concave. Thus exp(−x²/2) is log-concave but not globally concave. Log-concavity implies quasiconcavity; log-convexity implies convexity by the arithmetic–geometric mean bound.

乘积变成对数之和，故分别保持对数凸、对数凹。非负加权和保持对数凸；对数凹的和一般不保持，两个分离高斯峰可形成双峰。xᵃ 在 x>0 上按 a≤0 对数凸、a≥0 对数凹。Products preserve either property by addition of logarithms. Nonnegative sums preserve log-convexity but generally not log-concavity: separated Gaussian peaks can create two modes. On x>0, xᵃ is log-convex for a≤0 and log-concave for a≥0.

掌握Mastery

求导得 ∇²log f=(f∇²f−∇f∇fᵀ)/f²，检查其半正定或半负定。高斯 CDF Φ 令 r=φ/Φ，则 (log Φ)″=−r(x)(x+r(x))≤0；x<0 时用 φ(x)=∫₋∞ˣ(−u)φ(u)du>−xΦ(x) 判符号。Compute ∇²log f=(f∇²f−∇f∇fᵀ)/f² and test its sign. For Gaussian CDF Φ, let r=φ/Φ; then (log Φ)″=−r(x)(x+r(x))≤0, using φ(x)=∫₋∞ˣ(−u)φ(u)du>−xΦ(x) for x<0.

Gamma 的积分表达配合 Hölder 给对数凸。det X 对数凹来自 logdet 凹；det X/tr X 的对数方向曲率为 −tr(W²)+(tr H)²/(tr X)²≤0，W=X⁻½HX⁻½，末步用迹 Cauchy–Schwarz。Hölder applied to Gamma's integral proves log-convexity. Determinant is log-concave by concavity of logdet. For det X/tr X, log curvature is −tr(W²)+(tr H)²/(tr X)²≤0 with W=X⁻½HX⁻½, using trace Cauchy–Schwarz.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

f(x)=x 在 x>0 上是对数凸还是对数凹？Is f(x)=x on x>0 log-convex or log-concave?

展开核对Check the answer

log x 的二阶导数为 −1/x²，因此对数凹；f 自身仿射，仍凸且凹。Log x has second derivative −1/x², so f is log-concave. The function itself is affine, hence both convex and concave.

深入In depth

含零值的对数凹函数需用 log0=−∞ 的扩展约定，并检查支撑集凸性。For zero-valued log-concave functions, use log0=−∞ and check convexity of the support.

核对原课件 · 27-29Check original slides · 27-29

46 · 广义不等式下的凸性46 · Convexity with values in an ordered vector space

Lecture 5 · PDF pp.31-36 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.6.2 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：把标量不等式推广到向量和矩阵；用锥及标量化判定。Learning goal: explain convexity with values in an ordered vector space and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

K-凸用锥序比较函数值，等价于所有对偶权重的标量化凸。 compares outputs by cone order and equals convexity under every dual scalarization.

了解Understand

输出为向量时，用正常锥 K 比较混合值，称 K-凸。K 为非负正交象限即各分量凸；PSD 序则比较所有方向二次型。F(x)=xxᵀ 是矩阵凸，虽非每个条目都凸。For vector outputs, K-convexity compares mixture values using a proper cone. The nonnegative orthant means componentwise convexity; PSD order compares all quadratic directions. F(x)=xxᵀ is matrix-convex although its entries need not be convex.

矩阵例子 XXᵀ 的混合差为 θ(1−θ)(X−Y)(X−Y)ᵀ⪰0。正定矩阵幂 Xᵖ 在 −1≤p≤0 或 1≤p≤2 矩阵凸，在 0≤p≤1 矩阵凹，范围与标量幂不同。For XXᵀ the mixture gap is θ(1−θ)(X−Y)(X−Y)ᵀ⪰0. Positive definite powers Xᵖ are matrix-convex for −1≤p≤0 or 1≤p≤2, and matrix-concave for 0≤p≤1, differing from scalar powers.

内层 g 为 K-凸、外层 h 凸且按 K 非减时，复合仍凸。例如 A⪰0 下 g(X)=XᵀAX+BᵀX+XᵀB+C，−logdet(−g(X)) 在 g(X)≺0 上凸。A K-convex inner map and convex K-nondecreasing outer function preserve convexity. For A⪰0 and g(X)=XᵀAX+BᵀX+XᵀB+C, this gives convex −logdet(−g(X)) on g(X)≺0.

掌握Mastery

f K-凸等价于每个 λ∈K* 的标量函数 λᵀf 凸，反向用 K**=K。故一阶条件为 f(y)⪰K f(x)+Df(x)(y−x)；二阶条件为 D²f(x)[v,v]∈K。K-convexity is equivalent to convexity of λᵀf for all λ∈K*, using K**=K for the converse. Its first-order condition is f(y)⪰K f(x)+Df(x)(y−x); the second-order condition is D²f(x)[v,v]∈K.

复合例中 X,B 为 m×n、A 为 m×m、C 为 n×n。内层混合差为 θ(1−θ)(X−Y)ᵀA(X−Y)⪰0；外层沿 PSD 增量 H 的导数 tr((−Y)⁻¹H)≥0，给出所需单调性。In the example X,B are m×n, A m×m and C n×n. The inner gap is θ(1−θ)(X−Y)ᵀA(X−Y)⪰0. The outer derivative along PSD H is tr((−Y)⁻¹H)≥0, proving monotonicity.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

f(x)=(x²,eˣ) 在正交象限序下凸吗？给一个标量化。Is f(x)=(x²,eˣ) orthant-convex? Give a scalarization.

展开核对Check the answer

两分量都凸，故是；例如权重 (1,2) 给 x²+2eˣ，仍凸。Both components are convex. Weights (1,2) give the convex scalarization x²+2eˣ.

深入In depth

广义上图集 {(x,t):f(x)⪯K t} 凸恰好等价于 f K-凸。The generalized epigraph {(x,t):f(x)⪯K t} is convex iff f is K-convex.

核对原课件 · 31-36Check original slides · 31-36

47 · 广义单调性47 · Generalized monotonicity and the course connections

Lecture 5 · PDF pp.37 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.6.1 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：说明输入、输出锥与定义域；与广义凸性建立联系。Learning goal: explain and the course connections and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

保持输入、输出锥序；导数需把输入锥映入输出锥。Generalized monotonicity preserves cone orders; derivatives must map the input cone into the output cone.

了解Understand

多变量单调性须指定输入锥 K、输出锥 L：y−x∈K 时要求 f(y)−f(x)∈L。逐分量序下，f(x₁,x₂)=x₁+2x₂ 非减，x₁−x₂ 则沿 (0,1) 下降。Multivariate monotonicity requires input cone K and output cone L: y−x∈K must imply f(y)−f(x)∈L. In componentwise order, x₁+2x₂ is nondecreasing, while x₁−x₂ decreases along (0,1).

在开放凸域上可微时检查 Df(x)K⊂L，即每个允许的输入方向都映成非负输出方向。矩阵序也须按整体锥判断，逐元素导数符号通常不够。For differentiable f on an open convex domain, test Df(x)K⊂L: every allowed input direction must map to a nonnegative output direction. Matrix orders require whole-cone tests, not merely entrywise signs.

掌握Mastery

在开放凸域上，令 v=y−x∈K，积分 f(y)−f(x)=∫₀¹Df(x+tv)v dt。各项在闭凸锥 L 中，积分也在其中。必要性由小步差商传极限得到。On an open convex domain, integrate f(y)−f(x)=∫₀¹Df(x+tv)v dt with v=y−x∈K. The integral stays in closed convex L. Necessity follows from small-step difference quotients and limits.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

线性映射 f(x)=Ax 在正交象限序下单调的充要条件是什么？What characterizes orthant-monotonicity of the linear map Ax?

展开核对Check the answer

A 每个元素都非负。充分性由非负向量相乘得到；必要性取输入方向为每个坐标单位向量，要求 A 的每一列都非负。Every entry of A must be nonnegative. Sufficiency follows by multiplication; necessity follows by testing each coordinate unit vector and hence every column.

深入In depth

这些工具将用于标准形式、Lagrange 对偶与 KKT 条件；目前先掌握定义域、可行变化和线性评分的联系。These tools lead to standard forms, Lagrange duality and KKT conditions; first connect domains, feasible changes and linear scores.

随时查阅A reading reference 当前层新增Added at this level

中文Chinese英文English符号Symbol解释Meaning位置Context
norm‖x‖范数把一个向量变成一个非负数，用这个数表示它的长度。它要求：只有零向量的长度为零；向量乘以 t 后，长度乘以 |t|；两段路接起来的长度不超过各段长度之和。选用不同范数，相当于采用不同的长度规则。A norm assigns a nonnegative length to each vector. Only the zero vector has length zero; multiplying a vector by t multiplies its length by |t|; and the length of a sum is at most the sum of the lengths. Different norms use different rules for measuring length.前往讲解Read
unit ballB所有长度不超过 1 的向量；本章使用闭单位球。The set of vectors whose norm is at most one; the closed unit ball is used here.前往讲解Read
inner productzᵀx这里用标准内积：对应分量乘积之和。Here the standard inner product is the sum of componentwise products.前往讲解Read
supremumsupsup 是 supremum 的缩写。上确界是能够挡住所有可能数值的最小上界；它可以存在而没有任何点实际达到它。例如 x∈(0,1) 时，x 的上确界是 1，但没有最大值。The abbreviation sup stands for supremum. A supremum is the least upper bound on all possible values, and it may exist without being attained. For x∈(0,1), the supremum of x is one, but there is no maximum.前往讲解Read
maximummaxmax 是 maximum 的缩写。说一个数是最大值，需要找到一个可行点实际取得这个数，还需要说明其他可行点都不超过它。本章的有限维闭单位球上，线性目标可以取得最大值。The abbreviation max stands for maximum. A maximum is both attained by a feasible point and at least as large as every other feasible value. The linear objective in this chapter attains a maximum on the finite-dimensional closed unit ball.前往讲解Read
dual norm‖z‖*先选定一个原范数，再固定向量 z。让 x 在原范数的单位球中移动，计算每个可行 x 的 zᵀx。所有这些内积的最大值，就是 z 的对偶范数。它的数值取决于原范数使用的长度规则。Choose a primal norm and fix a vector z. Let x vary over the primal unit ball and evaluate zᵀx at every feasible x. The largest value is the dual norm of z. Its value depends on the length rule used by the primal norm.前往讲解Read
support functionh_B(z)给定集合 B 和方向 z，取 sup{x∈B} zᵀx。For a set B and direction z, the supremum of zᵀx over B.前往讲解Read
Hölder inequality1/p+1/q=1共轭指数对应的内积界：|zᵀx|≤‖x‖p‖z‖q。An inner-product bound for conjugate exponents: |zᵀx|≤‖x‖p‖z‖q.前往讲解Read
Cauchy–Schwarz inequality|uᵀv|≤‖u‖₂‖v‖₂这个不等式给欧氏内积一个长度上界。两个非零向量同向时，uᵀv 等于长度的乘积；方向偏离时，内积会变小。本章用它先找上界，再沿正确方向构造达到上界的向量。This inequality bounds a Euclidean inner product by the product of the vector lengths. For nonzero vectors pointing in the same direction, uᵀv equals that product; changing their relative direction reduces the inner product. We use it to find a bound and then construct an attaining vector.前往讲解Read
positive definite matrixP≻0 / PDPD = Positive Definite，正定。这里 P 必须是实对称矩阵；对每个非零向量 x，都有 xᵀPx>0。这个条件让每一个非零方向都有正的长度代价，并保证 P 可以求逆。PD = Positive Definite（正定）. Here P is real and symmetric, and xᵀPx>0 for every nonzero vector x. Every nonzero direction therefore has a positive length cost, and P is invertible.前往讲解Read
positive semidefinite matrixP⪰0 / PSDPSD = Positive Semidefinite，半正定。对实对称矩阵 P，要求所有 x 满足 xᵀPx≥0；允许某个非零向量的二次型为零。因此 P 可能不可逆，√(xᵀPx) 也可能不满足范数“非零向量长度为正”的要求。PSD = Positive Semidefinite（半正定）. For a real symmetric P, xᵀPx≥0 for every x, but the quadratic form can vanish at a nonzero vector. P may be singular, and √(xᵀPx) may fail the definiteness requirement of a norm.前往讲解Read
quadratic norm‖x‖P由正定矩阵 P 定义的 √(xᵀPx)。The norm √(xᵀPx) defined by a positive definite matrix P.前往讲解Read
matrix square rootP½对正定 P，P½ 表示一个正定矩阵 S，使得 S²=P。它通常不能通过对每个矩阵元素分别开平方得到。利用正交特征分解，把正特征值逐个开平方，可以构造这个 S。For positive definite P, P½ denotes a positive definite matrix S satisfying S²=P. It is generally not obtained by taking square roots of individual matrix entries. An orthogonal eigenvalue decomposition constructs S by taking square roots of the positive eigenvalues.前往讲解Read
maximizerx* / argmax最大化点是一个可行向量：把它代入目标后，目标实际达到最大值。本章 x* 上的星号标记我们选出的最大化点。x* 是向量，最大值是一个数；这两种对象需要分清。A maximizer is a feasible vector at which the objective attains its maximum. The star on x* marks such a chosen vector. A maximizer is a vector, while the maximum value is a number; they are different kinds of objects.前往讲解Read
ellipsoidxᵀPx≤1正定二次型的单位球；在二维是椭圆及内部。The unit ball of a positive definite quadratic form; an ellipse with its interior in two dimensions.前往讲解Read
polar setB°B°={z: zᵀx≤1 对所有 x∈B}；对偶单位球等于原单位球的极集。B°={z: zᵀx≤1 for all x∈B}; the dual unit ball is the polar of the primal ball.前往讲解Read
conjugate functionf*定义为 sup_x(zᵀx−f(x))；与对偶范数的星号含义需区分。Defined as sup_x(zᵀx−f(x)); its star denotes function conjugacy.前往讲解Read
spectral norm‖Z‖₂矩阵的最大奇异值；等于由欧氏范数诱导的算子范数。The largest singular value of a matrix; the operator norm induced by Euclidean norms.前往讲解Read
nuclear norm‖Z‖nuc矩阵奇异值之和；在迹内积下是谱范数的对偶。The sum of singular values; the dual of the spectral norm under the trace inner product.前往讲解Read

Singular Value DecompositionSVDSVD = Singular Value Decomposition，奇异值分解；矩阵写成 UΣVᵀ。SVD = Singular Value Decomposition（奇异值分解）; a matrix is written UΣVᵀ.前往讲解Read
second-order coneSOCSOC = Second-Order Cone，二阶锥；{(x,t):‖x‖₂≤t}。SOC = Second-Order Cone（二阶锥）; the set {(x,t):‖x‖₂≤t}.前往讲解Read
sign functionsgnsgn 是 sign 的惯用缩写。符号函数对正数返回 1，对负数返回 −1，对零返回 0。取 xᵢ=sgn(zᵢ) 可以让乘积 zᵢxᵢ=|zᵢ|。The notation sgn is a conventional abbreviation of sign. The sign function returns one for a positive number, minus one for a negative number and zero at zero. Choosing xᵢ=sgn(zᵢ) makes zᵢxᵢ=|zᵢ|.前往讲解Read
diagonal-matrix notationdiagdiag 是 diagonal 的缩写。diag(a,b) 表示主对角线为 a、b，其他位置均为零的二维方阵。只有对角矩阵求逆时，才可以直接对这些非零对角元素取倒数。The notation diag abbreviates diagonal. The matrix diag(a,b) has a and b on its main diagonal and zero elsewhere. Taking reciprocals of nonzero diagonal entries gives the inverse specifically for a diagonal matrix.前往讲解Read
tracetrtr 是 trace 的缩写，表示方阵主对角线元素的和。矩阵内积 tr(ZᵀX) 等于 Z 与 X 对应元素乘积的总和，可以理解为把矩阵摊平成向量后的内积。The notation tr abbreviates trace, the sum of a square matrix’s diagonal entries. nullspaceN(A)被矩阵映为零的全部输入构成的子空间。The subspace of inputs mapped to zero.前往讲解Read
eigenvalueλ满足 Av=λv 的方向缩放系数，其中 v 非零。A directional scale factor satisfying Av=λv for a nonzero vector v.前往讲解Read
pseudoinverseA†通过 SVD 反转非零奇异值并保留零方向为零的矩阵。The matrix obtained from SVD by inverting nonzero singular values and retaining zeros.前往讲解Read
Schur complementC−BᵀA⁻¹B正定块消元或配方后留下的对称块。The symmetric block remaining after eliminating a positive definite block.前往讲解Read
affine setaff C包含任意两点所在整条直线的集合。A set containing the whole line through every pair of its points.前往讲解Read
convex setC包含任意两点间线段的集合。A set containing the segment between every pair of its points.前往讲解Read
convex hullconv C包含原集合的最小凸集，由所有有限凸组合构成。The smallest convex set containing the original set, consisting of all finite convex combinations.前往讲解Read
hyperplaneaᵀx=b非零法向给出的一个仿射等式集合。An affine equality set defined by a nonzero normal.前往讲解Read
halfspaceaᵀx≤b超平面的一侧，闭半空间包括边界。One side of a hyperplane; a closed halfspace includes its boundary.前往讲解Read
polyhedronGx≤h有限个半空间与超平面的交，可以无界。An intersection of finitely many halfspaces and hyperplanes, possibly unbounded.前往讲解Read
simplexΔ仿射独立顶点的凸包，标准形式记录非负且和为 1 的权重。The hull of affinely independent vertices; the standard form represents nonnegative weights summing to one.前往讲解Read
preimagef⁻¹(C)输出落入指定集合的全部输入，不要求映射可逆。All inputs whose outputs belong to a specified set, without requiring invertibility.前往讲解Read
perspective mapz/t在正高度 t 上把水平坐标除以 t 的映射。The map dividing horizontal coordinates by positive height t.前往讲解Read
proper coneK闭、凸、尖且内部非空的锥，可定义偏序。A closed convex pointed cone with nonempty interior, suitable for defining a partial order.前往讲解Read
pointednessK∩(−K)={0}锥不包含任何经过原点的非零双向直线。The absence of any nonzero two-sided line through the origin in a cone.前往讲解Read
minimum elementmin按选定偏序不大于集合全部元素的点。A point below every element under the chosen order.前往讲解Read
minimal elementPareto没有另一个不同元素按偏序不大于它的点。A point with no distinct element below it under the order.前往讲解Read
separating hyperplaneaᵀx=b将两个集合置于相反两侧的超平面，弱分离允许边界取等。A hyperplane placing two sets on opposite sides, with boundary equality allowed in weak separation.前往讲解Read
supporting hyperplaneaᵀx≤aᵀx₀通过边界点并将整个集合留在同一侧的超平面。A hyperplane through a boundary point with the entire set on one side.前往讲解Read
dual coneK*与原锥所有点内积非负的向量组成的锥。The cone of vectors pairing nonnegatively with every primal-cone point.前往讲解Read
Pareto frontierf(x)多目标比较下未被其他方案支配的目标点集合。The set of objective points undominated by other plans.前往讲解Read
convex functionf在凸定义域上，混合输入的函数值不超过输出的加权平均。A function on a convex domain whose mixture value is at most the weighted average of endpoint values.前往讲解Read
convex indicator functionδC在集合内取 0，在集合外取 +∞，用来编码约束。A function equal to zero inside a set and +∞ outside, encoding a constraint.前往讲解Read
subgradient∂f给出全局仿射下界的斜率，适用于不可微凸函数。A slope defining a global affine lower bound, including at nondifferentiable convex points.前往讲解Read
epigraphepi f包含函数图像及上方所有点的集合。The set consisting of the graph and all points above it.前往讲解Read
sublevel setf≤α函数值不超过固定门槛的输入集合。The inputs whose function values are no greater than a fixed threshold.前往讲解Read
Linear Matrix InequalityLMI变量以仿射方式出现在对称矩阵中，并要求该矩阵半正定。A PSD constraint on a symmetric matrix depending affinely on the variables.前往讲解Read
Jensen inequalityf(E X)≤E f(X)凸函数在平均输入处的值不超过输出的平均。Evaluation of a convex function at an average is no greater than averaging its values.前往讲解Read
partial minimizationinf_y消去部分决策变量，保留其可取得的最佳费用。Eliminating some decision variables while retaining their best attainable cost or infimum.前往讲解Read
Fenchel inequalityf+f*≥〈x,y〉由共轭定义得到的内积上界，取等表示共轭最大化。The inner-product bound from conjugacy, with equality at a conjugate maximizer.前往讲解Read
quasiconvexf(mix)≤max所有次水平集凸，混合点不超过两端较大值。Having convex sublevel sets, or mixture values no greater than the larger endpoint value.前往讲解Read
log-convexlog f convex正函数的对数为凸函数。A positive function with convex logarithm.前往讲解Read
log-concavelog f concave正函数的对数为凹函数。A positive function with concave logarithm.前往讲解Read
K-convexity⪯K用锥序代替标量不等式的向量值函数凸性。Convexity of a vector-valued function using cone order in place of scalar order.前往讲解Read
generalized monotonicityDf K⊂L输入按指定锥序增加时，输出也按其锥序增加。Preservation of specified input and output cone orders.前往讲解Read
